definitionZh: *-moz-range-progress CSS伪元素是一个Mozilla扩展,代表了音轨的下部(即groove),其中指标滑动在类型="距离"的输入中. 此部分对应的值低于拇指当前选择的值(即虚拟 knob).
sourceDefinition: The ::-moz-range-progress CSS pseudo-element is a Mozilla extension that represents the lower portion of the track (i.e., groove) in which the indicator slides in an input of type="range". This portion corresponds to values lower than the value currently selected by the thumb (i.e., virtual knob).
